name: Conveyor Cash Farm
description: A stable cash-first car setup that keeps earning while you save for better crates and more garage space.
signals: Easy to keep running while upgrading
rerollAdvice: Prioritize this before chasing rare flex parts. Cash flow makes every later roll safer.

name: Rare Parts Showcase
description: A build slot reserved for your rarest compatible parts so you can keep value without breaking your income car.
signals: Not needed for basic cash production
rerollAdvice: Keep rare parts separated from grind parts so an upgrade experiment does not ruin your best showcase.

name: Balanced Daily Driver
description: A flexible car that uses your best non-premium parts while saving rare boxes for a clear milestone.
rerollAdvice: Upgrade gradually. Do not dismantle the whole car unless a new crate clearly improves two or more slots.

name: Dealer Flip Build
description: A practical setup for turning spare parts and code cash into better crate attempts without touching your main car.
rerollAdvice: Use this when your garage is cluttered. Protect rare parts and flip the rest into upgrade attempts.

name: Merge Test Slot
description: A separate build slot for merge experiments so you can learn the system without sacrificing your best income setup.
rerollAdvice: Only test merges with parts you can afford to lose. Keep screenshots or notes for repeatable results.

name: Speed Roll Chaser
description: A fun build path that chases exciting parts, but it can drain cash if you chase every crate upgrade too early.
rerollAdvice: Use only after your conveyor farm can recover the cost of a bad roll session.

name: Starter Box Build
description: The first functional car assembled from early boxes. It is useful for learning, but should not trap your cash.
rerollAdvice: Replace one slot at a time as code cash and better crates arrive.

name: Dead Slot Collector
description: A car that exists only because random parts were attached without a cash, rarity, or upgrade plan.
signals: Hard to decide what to upgrade
rerollAdvice: Break it down into spare parts and rebuild around cash generation or rarity collection.
